required_transformations: Aggregate daily signup counts by city_tier and signup_date
Compute conversion rate using derived converted_flag grouped by acquisition_channel
Calculate 7-day retention using retained_7d_flag grouped by cohort_week
No raw user-level data export, only aggregated outputs
justification: Aggregate outputs are sufficient to answer all three business questions, no raw export needed.
Policy enforces minimal internal query fields; only fields marked minimal_internal_query are allowed.
Credentials (password_hash, auth_token) and direct identifiers must never be released externally.
Prefer derived flags (converted_flag, retained_7d_flag) over raw timestamps for KPI calculation.
